ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions vs 20% low-intensity black pixels located along the perimeter and in linear/mottled clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white blobs dominate the interior of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing and leading edges, with significant dendritic mottling and linear streaks penetrating the white central fields from the outer boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch; central depression exhibits an approximate 50-degree angle with a well-defined pixel depth dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Left lobe shows two distinct, deep macro-indentations (tissue loss). Right lobe shows more consistent, low-amplitude peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending to acute, upwardly-tapered tips on the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, yellowish-white textured clusters (barnacles) localized on the distal tips of both lobes. A singular dark, circular high-contrast spot is visible in the right lobe's white field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white regions of both lobes, predominantly oriented horizontally and diagonally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large V-shaped excision/missing tissue on the upper trailing edge of the left lobe. Extensive rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent dark circular dot/spot located in the lower-right quadrant of the right lobe's white region.
